title: Home Purchase Financing Good-Faith Payment — Payment-History Multiplier
content:
**Payment history note — Home Purchase Financing good-faith payments**

Where autopay on the loan has been cancelled and two or more payments were returned in the 12 whole months before the payment date, the good-faith payment-history multiplier is 1.1; where autopay is in force and no payment was returned in those 12 months, the good-faith payment-history multiplier is 0.9. In the remaining combinations no payment-history multiplier applies.

The multiplier applies to the good-faith payment amount before it is rounded, the payment being rounded half up to the cent once at the end. Whether autopay is in force is shown on the loan record; the returns are the payment returns recorded on the loan's transactions, by their dates.

### Truth table

| Autopay on the loan | Payments returned in the 12 whole months before the payment date | Payment-history multiplier |
|---|---|---|
| cancelled | 2 or more | 1.1 |
| cancelled | 0 or 1 | none applies |
| in force | none | 0.9 |
| in force | 1 or more | none applies |

*Hypothetical example.* An unrounded good-faith amount of 300.00 on a loan paying by autopay with a clean year becomes 270.00; on a loan whose autopay was cancelled after three returns in the 12 months it becomes 330.00.
